results.check: A2 V4 gradient matches an independent complex-step derivative
results.detail: max rel deviation 1.743e-16 (complex-step h = 1e-20, no truncation error)
results.refuter: a mismatch would mean the force driving every run is not dV4/dM

results.check: A1 the background enters the dynamics ONLY through the trace targets C_p(sg)
results.detail: dV4/dsg analytic 40.87354581 vs central FD 40.87354868 (rel 7.01e-08); truncation falls 4.00x on halving h (O(h^2) expected 4x); the sg dependence of V4 is exactly C_p = sg^p + 1 + delta^p
results.refuter: any additional sg channel would break this identity and invalidate the host-side drive construction

results.check: A5 on the STAGED (block-diagonal) states the uniform drive force commutes with M: it moves eigenvalues and cannot torque the clock frame
results.detail: ||[dF/dsg, M]||rel = 4.544e-21 block-diagonal (machine zero) vs 1.383e-02 with the mixed (0,i) block present. So the null is STRUCTURAL for phase A, and the mixed block is the missing coupling channel
results.refuter: if the block-diagonal commutator were nonzero, a uniform spectral drive could torque the clock directly and a null tongue would need another explanation; if the general-M commutator were ALSO zero, the mixed block would not be the channel and phase B would need a different design

results.check: A3 the field energy change is accounted by the explicit drive work
results.detail: dE = +23.3894 vs Int (dV4/dsg) dsg = +22.6727 (rel gap 0.03; a coarse independent discretization, so the bar is order-of-magnitude)
results.refuter: a ledger that does not close means 'zero average drive power' cannot discriminate entrainment from pumping

results.check: A4 INDEPENDENT: a background drive at the clock frequency does not sustain the carried J above control
results.detail: J retention: control +0.0883, driven 1:1 +0.0524 (gain -0.0359), driven 2:1 -0.1254 (gain -0.2137) on an independent numpy integrator with a non-eta curvature term
results.refuter: if THIS build sustained J where the taichi run does not, the main NULL would be an artifact of the production discretization
